auth.note: Bearer key required on /v1/*. Host allowlist blocks DNS-rebinding; on the tailnet add the MagicDNS name + 100.x IP.

vibeproxy.note: BYOM — your OAuth subscriptions (Claude / Codex / Gemini / Antigravity) + Z.AI.

openrouter.note: BYOK — your provider keys + 356-model catalog. Lights up when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set.

ollama.note: Local inference — the only lane allowed for restricted / sensitive content.

hiddenModelsNote: Vetted broken via tools/model-probe (404 / empty / image-only). Dropped from /v1/models. Re-probe: python3 tools/model-probe/probe.py.

auto.description: Tri-harness router picks the cheapest privacy-safe lane for the request.

private.description: Forces a local-only lane regardless of content.

fusion.description: Fan-out to the 3 strongest diverse lanes (Opus 4.8 / GPT-5.5 / Gemini 3 Pro High), synthesize. Probe-verified working 2026-06-13.

routing.byTaskNote: Models re-picked from the probe-verified catalog 2026-06-13. Opus 4.8 = latest. cheap uses lean gemini (Claude lanes carry ~1.4-1.9k token system-prompt overhead). Thinking levels are id suffixes: *-high / *-thinking.
